# RFCs

Substantive changes to the spec, safety charter, governance, or
required protocol go through an RFC. See [CONTRIBUTING §5](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#how-to-propose-a-spec-or-safety-change-rfc).

## How to file one

1. Copy `0000-template.md` to `<NNNN>-<slug>.md` where `NNNN` is the
   next free number.
2. Open a PR. The PR is the discussion.
3. Minimum 7 days of review before a decision.
4. BDFL accepts or rejects, in writing, in the PR.

## Lifecycle

```
Draft → Review (≥7d) → Accepted / Rejected / Superseded
```
